minutes.headline: Water district heard the Route 2A culvert water main work is set for spring; businesses may extend a main on Shirley Road.
minutes.summary: A short Water District meeting. Commissioners approved the March 10 minutes and heard that a state culvert project on Route 2A will include replacing a section of the district's water main, with the district paying for the pipe work. A request from businesses to privately extend the water main past Route 70 on Shirley Road drew support so long as it costs the district nothing. The chair also asked about counting votes at Saturday's meeting.

budget_items.topic: Water main section at Route 2A culvert
budget_items.what_was_said: The district must pay for the pipe installation on the replaced section of main, while the state handles paving. Described as a considerable saving to the district.

budget_items.topic: Privately funded water main extension, Shirley Road
budget_items.what_was_said: Businesses would pay to extend the main, and the board's condition was that it cost the district nothing. Private installation was described as costing about half what the district would pay.

decisions.decision: Members voiced no objection to businesses engineering and funding a water main extension on Shirley Road past Route 70, provided it costs the district nothing; the superintendent will pass this on.
For Saturday's meeting, voice votes will be used if clear, but a count will be taken if a vote seems close.

what_happened.line: Commissioners heard that a state culvert project on Route 2A will include replacing a section of the district's water main, with the district paying for the pipe work.
Members voiced no objection to businesses engineering and funding a water main extension on Shirley Road past Route 70, so long as it costs the district nothing.
The board agreed that voice votes will be used at Saturday's meeting if clear, with a count taken if a vote seems close.
Commissioners approved the prior minutes and warrants; the minutes record no other votes at this meeting.

why_it_matters: The district pays for the pipe on the Route 2A section of main, so the work is a district cost, though it was described as a considerable saving because it coincides with the state's culvert project.
A privately funded main extension on Shirley Road would add pipe to the district's system without district money, but it was a no-objection position with no vote, so terms and ownership remain open.
